entries.source: Enter the Tunnels of the Forsaken and be careful of occasional Wind Rider patrols. Head towards the objective marker and talk to Ghost of Althea. From there, head straight north, up the hill, and kill the bandits at the camp until you get a Elemental Keystone. Pick it up and bring it to the crystal gate in the north to open it, then enter the second level.
entries.text: 進入 Tunnels of the Forsaken，留意偶爾出現的 Wind Rider 巡邏隊。朝目標標記前進，與 Ghost of Althea 交談。接著往正北方上坡，擊殺營地裡的盜賊，直到取得 Elemental Keystone。拾起它，帶到北方的水晶門開門，再進入第二層。
entries.reason: 完整保留先交談、正北上坡、打盜賊取得並拾起鑰石、帶去北門與進入第二層的順序。

entries.source: Entering the range of a pyre will initiate the spawning of Furious Ghosts, which will run towards the pyre until it is ignited. The rate at which the bar progresses depends on the difference between the number of party members in range minus the number of foes. Heroes and henchmen might often hinder this by fleeing out of the pyre's range unless they are repeatedly flagged inside; equipping all heroes with melee weapons mitigates this behaviour. If the party lacks the damage to clear the Furious Ghosts quickly enough, one or more members can attempt to tank them outside of the pyre range while another party member stands in the capture zone. Once the pyre has been ignited, the remaining Furious Ghosts will despawn.
entries.text: 進入柴堆範圍後，Furious Ghosts 就會開始出現，並持續跑向柴堆，直到柴堆被點燃。進度條的推進速度取決於範圍內隊員數減去敵人數的差值。英雄與傭兵經常會逃出柴堆範圍，妨礙進度；可反覆在範圍內插旗，命令他們留在裡面。讓所有英雄裝備近戰武器，可減少這種逃離行為。若隊伍無法迅速清除 Furious Ghosts，可讓一名或多名隊員在柴堆範圍外承受牠們的攻擊，另派一名隊員留在佔領區內。柴堆點燃後，剩餘的 Furious Ghosts 便會消失。
entries.reason: 進度依隊員數減敵人數，不是單看隊員數；保留英雄插旗、近戰裝備、區外扛怪及點燃後消失的各項機制。

entries.source: Follow the quest marker after entering the area (the left path is a dead end anyway). Walk towards the three pyres indicated on the map. To ignite a pyre, simply stand close to it (a charging bar will appear) until the quest updates and flames appear; no particular item is needed. It is recommended to make sure the area is clear of Blunted, Fractured, and Withered Spirits before entering the pyre's area, as they can easily overwhelm the group when paired with the continuously respawning Furious Ghosts.
entries.text: 進入區域後，沿任務標記前進；左邊的路是死路。前往地圖標示的三處柴堆。要點燃柴堆，只需站在附近，等待進度條充滿、任務更新並出現火焰，不需要特定物品。建議進入柴堆範圍前，先清除附近的 Blunted Spirits、Fractured Spirits 與 Withered Spirits；牠們若與不斷重生的 Furious Ghosts 一同進攻，很容易使隊伍不堪負荷。
entries.reason: 保留三處柴堆、站在附近充能且不需物品的機制；先清除三類靈體的建議與持續重生敵人的因果分開。

entries.source: If the party is worried that the charging waves may be overwhelming, consider clearing the areas south and east of the docks first. Just out of sight north of the beach in the east is a narrow pathway, at the end of which is the location of all the foes that will charge the docks. The path is a great bottleneck for skills such as Panic, and Psychic Instability. The foes that charge the docks from the south side are not already present on the map and must be cleared once spawned.[Source claim needs verification] This will greatly reduce pressure and the party can focus on clearing only waves from the south.
entries.text: 若擔心衝向碼頭的敵人波次太多，可考慮先清除碼頭南方與東方區域。東側海灘北方、視線之外有一條狹窄小徑，盡頭便是會衝向碼頭的敵人所在處；小徑是適合使用 Panic、Psychic Instability 等技能的隘口。來源另記載，從南側攻向碼頭的敵人起初不在地圖上，必須等牠們出現後才清除【此出現方式的來源主張待核實】。預先清場可大幅減輕壓力，讓隊伍集中處理來自南方的波次。
entries.reason: 保留南、東、東側海灘北方與狹窄隘口的位置；南方敵人生成方式保留待核實資格，不把兩類敵人混為一談。

entries.source: If you are doing the quest for the first time and the first level of the dungeon contains high-level echoes, consider leaving and re-entering the dungeon after taking the quest to remove them.
entries.text: 若是首次進行此任務，而地城第一層出現高等級的 Echoes，可考慮接取任務後先離開，再重新進入地城，讓牠們消失。
entries.reason: 此建議限首次任務且第一層有高等級 Echoes；保留先接任務再離開重進的順序。

entries.source: If you have the Gain Norgu and Gain Goren quests in your quest log, or complete them [Source claim needs verification], this quest will still be available, but the follow up quests will not.
entries.text: 若任務日誌中有 Gain Norgu 與 Gain Goren，或已完成這些任務【已完成時的可接取情況仍待來源核實】，仍可接取本任務，但無法接取後續任務。
entries.reason: 保留任務日誌中存在與已完成兩種情況；verify 緊接已完成條件，不能把後續任務不可接取的主張視為全部已驗證。

entries.source: If you travel outside of the dungeon after recovering the stolen goods, the quest objectives will reset, but if you re-enter the dungeon they will return to where they should be, allowing you to complete the quest without redoing any steps.
entries.text: 取回失竊物品後，若離開地城，任務目標會重設；但重新進入地城後，目標會恢復到正確進度，無須重做任何步驟，便能完成任務。
entries.reason: 保留離開時暫時重設、再進入時恢復的兩階段行為；不誤報為永久丟失進度。

entries.source: In the end cinematic, the gender of the voice of the lead party member is often reversed (e.g. male Assassins will get a female voice). Also, if the lead party member is female, the character model from another (male) character in the group will be used. [Source claim needs verification] Unlike the other henchmen NPCs, if no party joined from Unwaking Waters (Luxon), Aeson uses a skill set that is different from the one he uses as a henchman.
entries.text: 結尾動畫中，領隊角色的配音性別經常顛倒，例如男性暗殺者會使用女性聲音。來源還記載，若領隊是女性，動畫會改用隊伍中另一名男性角色的模型【此模型替換的來源主張待核實】。與其他傭兵 NPC 不同，若沒有隊伍從 Unwaking Waters（勒克森）加入，Aeson 使用的技能配置會與他擔任傭兵時不同。
entries.reason: party member 與 character 均指隊員或角色；模型替換保留 verify，Aeson 技能差異另有無勒克森隊伍加入的限定。

entries.source: In the laboratory south of Rata Sum, survive Oola's security measures while you locate her.
entries.text: 在洛達頂點南方的實驗室中，一邊應付 Oola 的防禦措施、一邊尋找她，並確保存活。
entries.reason: 原遊戲目標寫 south，west 是 sic 註解；保留尋人期間必須存活的條件，不擅改為西南方。

entries.source: It is advisable to accept the following quest immediately, even if you do not intend to complete it yet, to prevent level 20 ghosts from populating the dungeon when you return.
entries.text: 建議立即接取下一個任務，即使暫時不打算完成；這樣可避免之後返回時，地城內出現 20 級鬼魂。
entries.reason: 這是接取下一任務的建議，並非要求立即完成；保留避免 20 級鬼魂出現的效果。

entries.source: It is advised to bring a full party, as well as skills and weapons dealing holy damage. This quest can be difficult with henchmen and not enough firepower, as the spawning rate of the Furious Ghosts is high and they attack from various angles, making AoE spells less effective. The henchmen are also quite frail, meaning that keeping them alive to light the pyres can be tedious.
entries.text: 建議組滿隊伍，並攜帶能造成神聖傷害的技能與武器。若使用傭兵且火力不足，此任務可能相當困難：Furious Ghosts 出現得很快，還會從不同方向進攻，降低範圍魔法的效果。傭兵也較脆弱，要讓他們存活並協助點燃柴堆，可能需要反覆照看。
entries.reason: 保留滿隊、神聖傷害及傭兵火力不足的條件；spawn 指敵人出現，AoE 為範圍效果，不把傭兵當成玩家角色。

entries.source: Kill 3 Prismatic Oozes in the Depths of Tyria.
entries.text: 在泰瑞亞地底（Depths of Tyria）擊殺 3 隻多彩烏茲。
entries.reason: 保留 3 隻目標與原文地區；多彩烏茲採中文身份，不將地區註解翻成另一任務地點。

entries.reason: Arachni 採中文名稱；Depths of Tyria 仍是原文地區，未擅改為地城名稱。

entries.source: Kill Rragar Maneater in the Depths of Tyria.

entries.reason: 使用 Rragar Maneater 的固定中文身份；地區仍照原目標，不混入 Wiki 對地城名的編輯註解。

entries.source: Leaving from Yak's Bend with a party of 6 makes capturing the pyres significantly easier, at the cost of a much longer journey to reach the dungeon.
entries.text: 從 Yak's Bend 以 6 人隊伍出發，能明顯降低佔領柴堆的難度，但前往地城的路程會長得多。
entries.reason: 保留 6 人隊伍的優點與路程較長的代價；不是把地城隊伍人數上限改成 6。

entries.source: On the second level, head forward and take the left side wherever possible, left around the tree, left of the crystal, left around the rock, left around the cauldron and go under the overpass. Take left again after the glowing altar, and when you see dialogue from Duke Willgrove, head straight to find him. Talk to the Duke to retrieve the stolen supplies, making sure that you have inventory space to receive them.
entries.text: 在第二層向前走，能走左側時就走左側：從樹的左邊繞過、走水晶左側、從岩石左邊繞過、從大鍋左邊繞過，再從高架通道下方通過。經過發光的祭壇後再次左轉；看到 Duke Willgrove 的對話時，直走便能找到他。與公爵交談取回失竊物資，並確認背包有空間接收。
entries.reason: 保留每一處左側路線、通道下方、祭壇後左轉與看到對話後直走的導航；物資需要背包空間。

entries.source: On the third level of the dungeon, follow the winding path forward. Bear in mind that the enemy groups here are positioned close together, so you may want to pull them to avoid being overwhelmed. After the second bend, the path widens out, and you will need to turn to the south just before the second resurrection shrine. An Enraged Phantom appears when you approach the enemy group there, and must be killed to obtain the Boss Key. Again, pulling is advisable to separate the Phantom, a dangerous elementalist boss, from the other ghosts guarding it. Once you have the key, continue along your original path towards the east, around the final bend to the Boss Lock.
entries.text: 在地城第三層，沿蜿蜒的道路前進。此處敵群相距很近，建議引怪分批應付，以免被圍攻。經過第二個彎道後，道路變寬；在第二座復活祭壇前往南轉。接近那裡的敵群時，Enraged Phantom 會出現，必須擊殺牠才能取得 Boss Key。牠是危險的元素使頭目，建議再次引怪，將牠與周圍守護的鬼魂分開。取得鑰匙後，回到原本路線繼續往東，繞過最後一個彎道，抵達 Boss Lock。
entries.reason: 逐項保留第二彎、第二復活祭壇前南轉、接近後出怪、擊殺取鑰匙、往東繞末彎開鎖的方向與條件。

entries.source: Players familiar with the Forsaken Tunnels will find this quest to proceed in a similar way, with the Duke at the same location as Maz Scourgeheart, without a boss key or lock.
entries.text: 熟悉 Forsaken Tunnels 的玩家會發現，此任務的行進方式相近。公爵位於 Maz Scourgeheart 所在的同一處，但此任務不需要頭目鑰匙，也沒有頭目鎖。
entries.reason: 比較的是行進路線與公爵位置；保留沒有頭目鑰匙或鎖的差異，不將相似地城當成同一任務。

entries.source: Proceed through the dungeon in the same way as the previous quest, taking the Elemental Keystone from the bandits north of Althea and carrying it to the gate at the north end of the first level, and hugging the left side to navigate the second level of the dungeon. The Ghost of Althea will accompany you on the second and third levels if you are doing the quest for the first time. The way to the third level is just beyond where you previously found Duke Willgrove, behind a rock wall which Althea demolishes.
entries.text: 按照上一個任務的走法穿過地城：在 Althea 北方的盜賊處取得 Elemental Keystone，帶到第一層最北端的大門；第二層則沿左側前進。首次進行此任務時，Ghost of Althea 會在第二層與第三層同行。通往第三層的路就在先前找到 Duke Willgrove 的位置後方，隔著一面由 Althea 摧毀的岩壁。

The traps are not likely to kill all your opponents, but they will weaken them sufficiently to allow your team to mop up the remnants. [Source claim needs verification]

entries.source: Take the quest Restoring Grenth's Monuments from the Reaper of the Labyrinth which will spawn three Terrorweb Dryders at the monument of Forgotten Vale. Destroy the Terrorwebs and speak to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale which appears after this. Have him teleport you back to the Reaper of the Labyrinth and take the Escort of Souls. After accepting this quest a group of six New Souls will spawn and start to walk to the vale. At the same time, four groups of 6 Mindblade Spectres will spawn, one in the starting point of the Underworld,[Source claim needs verification] one in the wide hallway that connects the Labyrinth to the Vale, at the gate between that hall and the vale, and finally one group of 6 Mindblade Spectres will spawn between Mayor Alegheri and the bridge to the Labyrinth.
entries.text: 向 Reaper of the Labyrinth 接取 Restoring Grenth's Monuments 後，Forgotten Vale 的紀念碑處會出現三隻 Terrorweb Dryders。消滅牠們，再與隨後出現的 Reaper of the Forgotten Vale 交談，請他將隊伍傳回 Reaper of the Labyrinth 處，接取 Escort of Souls。接取後，會出現一群六名 New Souls，開始走向山谷。同時會出現四群各 6 隻 Mindblade Spectres，位置分別為：冥界起點【此出現位置的來源主張待核實】、連接 Labyrinth 與 Vale 的寬走廊、該走廊與山谷之間的大門，以及 Mayor Alegheri 和通往 Labyrinth 的橋之間；最後一處也是一群 6 隻。
entries.reason: 保留兩任務的接取與傳送順序、三隻敵人、六名靈魂及四群各6隻的配置；只在原文標示的起點刷怪位置加待核實提示。

entries.text: 來源記載，接取此任務後，起始房間會額外出現一群 Mindblade Spectres；應先消滅這群敵人，再接取 Unwanted Guests。【來源主張待核實】
entries.reason: 保留額外一群、起始房間與先清除再接後續任務的順序；整個刷怪主張仍待核實。

entries.text: 來源記載，The Four Horsemen 會使四隻 Skeletons 出現。【來源主張待核實】

entries.source: The marker arrows above the Ghost of Althea and Duke Willgrove are not removed when you complete their objectives. The quest marker for Duke Willgrove will appear to point to the exit while on level two of the dungeon. When talking to Duke Willgrove, the chatbox displays "Quest Added" instead of "Quest Updated", and does so even if you have already completed the objective.
entries.text: 完成 Ghost of Althea 與 Duke Willgrove 各自的目標後，他們頭上的標記箭頭仍不會消失。在地城第二層時，Duke Willgrove 的任務標記看起來會指向出口。與他交談時，聊天視窗會顯示「Quest Added」（已新增任務），而非「Quest Updated」（任務已更新）；即使已完成該目標，也會如此。
entries.reason: 這三項是標記與訊息顯示異常，不代表目標未完成；保留兩個英文訊息的差異。

entries.source: The reward for this mission depends on how many Sunspear Recruits are still alive at the end. This tutorial's normal mode rewards are substantially less than that of other missions.
entries.text: 此主線任務的獎勵取決於結束時仍存活的日戟新兵數。這個教學任務在普通模式下的獎勵遠低於其他主線任務。
entries.reason: 保留結束時計算存活新兵的條件；獎勵較低僅指此教學任務的普通模式。

entries.source: The rewards are based on how many Sunspear Ghosts (including Kahdash) were killed during the mission.
entries.text: 獎勵取決於任務中死亡的日戟幽魂數，Kahdash 也計算在內。
entries.reason: 計數對象是死亡的友方日戟幽魂，包含 Kahdash；不是擊殺幽魂才增加獎勵。

entries.source: The spirits spawned in the ruined village area by the quest are hostile towards the regular spirit spawns outside.
entries.text: 此任務在廢村區域產生的靈體，會與區域外平常出現的靈體互相敵對。
entries.reason: 區分任務產生的靈體與區域外原有的靈體；hostile towards 說明兩群之間的敵對關係。

entries.source: To return the supplies to Althea on the first level of the dungeon, it is faster to map travel to Piken Square. Talk to Althea to return the stolen supplies, and again to accept the reward for the quest.
entries.text: 要把物資交還給地城第一層的 Althea，使用地圖旅行前往 Piken Square 會比較快。與 Althea 交談歸還失竊物資後，還要再交談一次，才能領取任務獎勵。
entries.reason: 地圖旅行是較快回程，不是直接在據點交物資；歸還與領獎是兩次交談。

entries.text: 前往鳳荷議院。

entries.source: Varny the Zealot is waiting at the far end of the cavern, and will send three waves of Manipulated Grawl to attack you. These grawl have low levels but come in large numbers. Keeping your distance helps to engage more carefully and recover between waves. The second wave includes the God-touched Grawl, a much stronger warrior boss, which becomes friendly when its health gets low, but does not attack the other grawl. Finally, Varny himself attacks with the last wave; he is a moderately powerful shutdown mesmer, but poses little threat by himself, so consider pulling the grawl away from him and dispatching them first. Once the final wave is defeated, the Zealot's Chest will spawn, and you can complete the quest by speaking to the Ghost of Althea.
entries.text: Varny the Zealot 在洞穴最深處等待，會派出三波 Manipulated Grawl 攻擊隊伍。這些 Grawl 等級不高，但數量很多。保持距離有助於謹慎交戰，並在各波之間恢復。第二波包含更強的戰士頭目 God-touched Grawl；牠在體力降低時會轉為友方，但不會攻擊其他 Grawl。最後一波中，Varny 也會親自進攻。他是具有一定壓制能力的幻術師，單獨應付時威脅不大；可考慮將 Grawl 引離他，先消滅 Grawl。擊敗最後一波後，Zealot's Chest 會出現，再與 Ghost of Althea 交談即可完成任務。
entries.reason: 保留三波攻勢、第二波頭目低體力轉友方但不攻擊同族、最後一波幻術師壓制能力，以及清場後出寶箱與交談完成的順序。

entries.source: When repeating the quest, it is possible to pull the various Manipulated Grawls in the boss room into a fight with the Echoes and Horsemen. It can thin their numbers significantly when finally facing the boss Varny, which is especially helpful in hard mode. This is not possible during a first run of the quest, because Echoes and Horsemen will not spawn yet.
entries.text: 重複進行此任務時，可將頭目房間內的 Manipulated Grawls 引去與 Echoes 和 Horsemen 交戰，藉此大幅削減最後面對 Varny 時的敵人數量，困難模式下尤其有用。首次進行此任務時無法使用此法，因為當時 Echoes 和 Horsemen 尚不會出現。
entries.reason: 引怪互鬥僅適用重複任務；首次不出現 Echoes 與 Horsemen，不能將這個限制漏譯。

entries.source: You can do this quest faster with a running build, since only some bandits on the first level have to be defeated, for the Elemental Keystone. Just make sure you bring something that can kill them (e.g. a party, a summoning stone, or even combat skills alongside your running ones).
entries.text: 使用跑圖配置可更快完成此任務，因為只需擊敗第一層的部分盜賊，以取得 Elemental Keystone。仍須準備能擊殺他們的手段，例如同行隊伍、召喚石，或在跑圖技能之外搭配戰鬥技能。
entries.reason: running build 指跑圖配置；只需擊敗部分盜賊，並不表示可以完全跳過戰鬥；party 指同行隊伍。
